svg.title: Event-Driven vs. Scheduled Batch: The Decision Path
svg.desc: A root question asks whether the business must react within seconds of an event. If no, the path leads to a scheduled/interval pipeline. If yes, a second question asks whether the event itself is durable state that must be retained, branching to an event-driven pattern with a durable Eventhouse cold path versus a lightweight Activator-only notification pattern. A third question on the durable branch asks whether replay is required, branching to an idempotent replay design versus a simple durable log with no replay contract.

text.aria-label: Full event-driven pattern with Eventhouse cold path

svg.text: Full event-driven pattern with Eventhouse cold path — Hot path for immediate action plus a durable Eventhouse/OneLake cold path.Event-Driven Frameworks in Microsoft Fabric

text.aria-label: Must the business react within seconds?

svg.text: Must the business react within seconds? — The root question: reaction-time requirement.Event-Driven Frameworks in Microsoft Fabric decision path — Is latency event-scale or batch-scale?, Must events be replayed?, Choose streaming, trigger, or scheduled execution
Durable log, no replay contract — Land the durable history but do not build a formal replay path.DECISION PATH

text.aria-label: Is replay of failed/delayed events required?
text.title: Is replay of failed/delayed events required? — Third question, on the durable branch: does the design need a replay contract?

text.aria-label: Use a scheduled or interval pipeline
text.title: Use a scheduled or interval pipeline — Minutes-to-hours latency is fine — a Data Factory pipeline schedule covers it.

text.aria-label: Is the event durable business state?
text.title: Is the event durable business state? — Second question: must the event be retained and queried later, or is it just a trigger?

path; an idempotency key prevents duplicate downstream

svg.text: Idempotent replay + dead-letter design — Add an explicit idempotency key and dead-letter/replay procedure.✓ Replay procedure
Activator-only notification pattern — Lightweight: evaluate and act, no durable cold-path storage.⚠ Notification treated as state
